title: fix(app-shell): rename designModeMenu.ts so no layout file differs from DesignModeMenu.tsx only in case
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi92ncfFpPUpTD8314otX5oaG)_
Fixes #36589
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在 Mac 上自己构建的开发者：以前应用壳构建报错、点「编辑应用」整页白屏，改后构建通过、能进入设计模式；线上构建本来不受影响，用户无感。
- 属于运行界面设计模式专题，修的是设计模式菜单合并时带进来的文件名冲突。
- 只是把一个辅助文件改了名、改了引用，不改任何功能；出错会是构建或测试直接失败，可以直接撤回。
- 无。

## What changes

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/` held the design-mode menu component `DesignModeMenu.tsx` beside its pure tree helpers `designModeMenu.ts`. On a case-insensitive file system (the macOS default) the sidebar's lazy `import('./DesignModeMenu.js')` tries `.ts` first and lands on the helper module (no default export): TS1149 in the app-shell build, and a white page when 「Edit app」 opens design mode.

Renamed with `git mv` (history kept, similarity 100%):

| Before | After |
|:---|:---|
| `layout/designModeMenu.ts` | `layout/designModeMenuModel.ts` |
| `layout/__tests__/designModeMenu-36363.test.ts` | `layout/__tests__/designModeMenuModel-36363.test.ts` |

Importers updated (one line each): `DesignModeMenu.tsx`, `designModeMenuSave.ts`, `__tests__/designModeMenuModel-36363.test.ts`, `__tests__/designModeMenuSave-36363.test.ts`. No other tracked file names the old module. No behaviour change. Changeset: `.changeset/36589-design-menu-casing.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell` patch).

### Repository scan: entries in one directory that differ only in letter case

Over `git ls-files` (every tracked path, 27245 files), per directory, three comparisons, all case-insensitive:

- **A**: full entry names (files and directories);
- **B**: module names, the file name minus its last extension (`./X.js` resolves to `x.ts` or `X.tsx`, so `foo.ts` / `Foo.tsx` is a pair);
- **C**: a file's module name against a sibling directory name.

| Tree | A | B | C |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `origin/main` c0eecb1f80 | 0 | 2: `layout/` `DesignModeMenu.tsx` / `designModeMenu.ts`; `layout/__tests__/` `DesignModeMenu-36363.test.tsx` / `designModeMenu-36363.test.ts` | 0 |
| this branch d097435bd1 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

Nothing outside `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/` was found, so nothing else is renamed. The scan was a one-off script, not a committed gate (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (both programs, `tsconfig.json` and `tsconfig.test.json`) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run build` (tsc + `check-dist-completeness`): pass, after building the dependency closure (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 68/68). `dist/layout/` now holds `DesignModeMenu.js` and `designModeMenuModel.js`, no `designModeMenu.js`.
- The three 36363 suites that import the renamed module or the component, unchanged apart from the import line: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 62 passed (62)`.
- Derived gate families at head `d097435bd1` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 38 commands): each run with stdin closed, 38 × exit 0; `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reads `38 derived, 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

<details><summary>Gate notes</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: the first run was killed by the container's memory cgroup (an OOM-kill of the vitest node process at about 10.8 GB RSS on a shared box), so it is not a test verdict. It was re-run with `--maxWorkers=2` and a 4 GB heap: `Test Files 172 passed | 2 skipped (174)`, `Tests 5127 passed | 2 skipped (5129)`.
- `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (against `origin/main` c0eecb1f80; no open PR shares a file).
- The whole app-shell suite was not run locally. Only the three suites that import the renamed files were run; `Test UI` in CI runs the rest.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **macOS: NOT MEASURED.** This container is Linux on a case-sensitive file system. Substitute reading: TypeScript's own `resolveModuleName` (bundler resolution, the package's setting) run from `UnifiedSidebar.tsx` against each tree with a host whose `fileExists` answers case-insensitively, as the macOS default volume does:
  - `origin/main`: `./DesignModeMenu.js` resolves to `layout/DesignModeMenu.ts`, which opens `layout/designModeMenu.ts` on disk. This reproduces the card's TS1149 file name, so it is the positive control.
  - this branch: `./DesignModeMenu.js` resolves to `layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx` (the component). The new `./designModeMenuModel.js` resolves to the helper module.
  - With scan B at 0 for the whole tree, no relative import anywhere can reach a different file by case alone. The 「Edit app」 white screen is a consequence of the same resolution and was not re-run here either.
- **The guard the card asks for is not added.** The card's item 2 is the coordinator's own addition, so the claim allows only strengthening a gate that already reads file names. None exists. Searched: the root `check:*` scripts and `scripts/`, `ui/scripts/check-*.mjs`, `ui/eslint-rules/`, and both ESLint configs. Gates that walk the tracked tree read file *contents* (`check:nul-bytes`, `ui/scripts/check-control-bytes.mjs`). Gates that touch names do so for another question: import reachability (`check-unreferenced-sources`), `vi.mock` specifiers (`check-vi-mock-specifiers`), product words (the product-neutral-renderer ratchet). A case-collision rule in any of them would be a new gate under an old name. TypeScript's `forceConsistentCasingInFileNames` is what reported TS1149 on macOS, but it can only fire on a case-insensitive host, so it never fires in CI. The gap stays open for the seat to decide on: no gate keeps a case-only pair out on Linux.

## Verification

- **Read first:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/DesignModeMenu.tsx` (the import block ending `from './designModeMenuModel.js'`), `ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout/designModeMenuSave.ts` (`rebaseMenuEdits` import).
- **Two-minute check:** `git ls-files ui/packages/app-shell/src/layout | grep -i 'designmodemenu\.'`. Expect `DesignModeMenu.tsx` only, with no second entry spelled the same apart from case.
